message:
The other day, we found ourselves in a little pickle when the power went out unexpectedly during dinner prep. Thankfully, we had our go-bags ready with flashlights, snacks, and even some cozy blankets. It was a simple moment, but we turned it into an impromptu candlelit picnic in the living room! 

As we shared some laughs and stories by candlelight, it hit us how being a bit prepared can create small wins that really brighten our day. Have you had a little win that turned a challenge into a memory? 😊
